name: Koi to H Shika Shiteinai!
source:
I, Kyuujin Shidou, was discovered to be related to the leader of the Mauki Group, the largest corporation in Japan. In order to succeed the leader, my grandfather who did not have much time left to live, I would need a spouse...... In other words, to have a wife, that was the necessary requirement. But even so, all my life, let alone a wife, I never had a girlfriend!

After much consideration, I decided to consult with my two female childhood friends. The deadline for choosing the successor, in other words, I would need to have a wife in three months. So only until that time, I wanted them to pretend to be my wives!

――The once in a lifetime request, but after that, falling in love, living together, and eventually developed into doing [i]ecchi[/i] things everyday, I never thought at the time that it would turn out this way.

Two childhood friends―― An extremely shy [i]ojousama[/i]・Kuranozono Iwai.
And a pure-hearted [i]gyaru[/i] in love・Kousaki Ririka.
Which one of them, is going to become my wife――!?

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://unisonshift.amusecraft.com/products/project32/#l_Story]official website[/url]]
translation:
我，九神嗣道，突然被发现与日本最大企业真宇城集团的掌门人有血缘关系。为了继承时日无多的祖父的位置，我必须有配偶……也就是说，结婚是必要条件。可别说妻子了，我这辈子，连女朋友都没交过！

考虑再三，我决定向两位女性青梅竹马求助。决定继承人的期限，也就是我必须结婚的期限，是三个月后。所以，在那之前，能不能请她们假扮我的妻子！

——本是一生一次的请求，可接下来却谈起恋爱、开始同居，最终发展成每天都在做[i]亲密的事[/i]。当时的我，完全没想到会变成这样。

两位青梅竹马——极度害羞的[i]大小姐[/i]仓之园祝。
以及陷入恋爱的纯情[i]辣妹[/i]幸崎莉莉卡。
究竟哪一位，会成为我的妻子——？！

[翻译并编辑自[url=https://unisonshift.amusecraft.com/products/project32/#l_Story]官方网站[/url]]
